svg.title: Collaboration and perspective increase across years
svg.desc: Collaboration and perspective increase across years. Average annual change in coded family prevalence, adjusted for venue and holding the technology composition fixed at 43.75% GenAI. Filled charcoal points show 2019 to 2025; hollow teal points show 2023 to 2025. Lines are pointwise 95% confidence intervals. Holm p-values account for all ten temporal tests within each window. This figure shows annual slopes, not overall technology differences. 2019–2025: 2,444 papers. 2023–2025: 1,390 papers. Explanation and visibility. 2019–2025: +1.16 percentage points per year; 95% interval -0.70 to +3.03; Holm p 1.000. 2023–2025: -0.21 percentage points per year; 95% interval -5.64 to +5.22; Holm p 1.000. Organisation and comparison. 2019–2025: +0.06 percentage points per year; 95% interval -1.73 to +1.84; Holm p 1.000. 2023–2025: -2.88 percentage points per year; 95% interval -6.68 to +0.93; Holm p 0.941. User control and expression. 2019–2025: -1.02 percentage points per year; 95% interval -2.44 to +0.41; Holm p 0.938. 2023–2025: -3.32 percentage points per year; 95% interval -6.48 to -0.16; Holm p 0.322. Guidance and feedback. 2019–2025: +1.58 percentage points per year; 95% interval +0.70 to +2.47; Holm p 0.008. 2023–2025: +1.87 percentage points per year; 95% interval -2.73 to +6.47; Holm p 1.000. Collaboration and perspective. 2019–2025: +1.10 percentage points per year; 95% interval +0.52 to +1.68; Holm p 0.005. 2023–2025: +2.67 percentage points per year; 95% interval +1.20 to +4.14; Holm p 0.007.
